{{Top|leg}}
'''Immersion holographic environments''' were advanced [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic image disguisers]] used in [[amusement park]]s such as [[Hologram Fun World]]. Connected to [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], the immersion holographic environments created complex [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] simulations that recreated exotic environments that was virtually indistinguishable from reality with full sensory feedback.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
